items.source: The auto-configuration classes that should be imported.
Exclude specific auto-configuration classes such that they will never be applied.
items.translation: 排除特定的自动配置类，使其永远不会被应用。

items.source: Can also be used to exclude() specific auto-configuration classes such that they will never be applied.
items.translation: 也可用于exclude()特定的自动配置类，使其永远不会被应用。

items.source: Generally, @EnableAutoConfiguration should be used in preference to this annotation, however, @ImportAutoConfiguration can be useful in some situations and especially when writing tests.
items.translation: 通常，应优先使用 @EnableAutoConfiguration 而非此注解，但在某些情况下（尤其是编写测试时），@ImportAutoConfiguration 可能非常有用。

items.source: The auto-configuration classes that should be imported. When empty, the classes are specified using a file in META-INF/spring where the file name is the fully-qualified name of the annotated class, suffixed with .imports. An entry in the file may be prefixed with optional: to indicate that the imported class should be ignored if it is not on the classpath.
items.translation: 应导入的自动配置类。当为空时，这些类通过 META-INF/spring 目录下的文件指定，文件名是带注解类的完全限定名，并附加后缀 .imports。文件中的条目可以以 optional: 开头，表示如果该导入的类不在类路径中则应被忽略。

items.source: The auto-configuration classes that should be imported. This is an alias for classes().
items.translation: 应导入的自动配置类。这是 classes() 的别名。
